hints.title: Substrings with Unique Characters
hints.text: To minimize the number of substrings, greedily extend the current substring as far right as possible until a duplicate letter is encountered.

hints.title: Current Substring Seen Set
hints.text: Track characters in the active substring using a hash set or bitmask.

hints.title: Substring Reset Trigger
hints.text: When character s[i] is already in the set, start a new substring with s[i] and increment the partition count.

hints.title: Greedy Substring Partition Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass with hash set containing at most 26 lowercase English letters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Partition searching via dynamic programming or recursion incurs exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set bound to 26 characters uses O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies greedy single-pass extension to minimize partition count.
